pitch:
Your salon's own Android app, with your salon's name and logo, installed on your phone and on each stylist's phone by us. In English.
Stylists type a walk-in's mobile number and bill the services in about a minute (cash, UPI, card or the customer's prepaid wallet), then send the bill on WhatsApp with one tap; each sees only their own earnings and bookings. Attendance check-in at the start of the day.
You see from anywhere who is in which chair right now (a live view of your salon), today's takings, attendance and leave, your top customers, and daily checks: cancelled bills, customers who left without service, and the cash that should be in the drawer.
Your customers get a WhatsApp reminder when they're due back (sent with one tap by staff), a prepaid wallet with bonus on top-ups, and ₹100 for bringing a friend.
₹10,000 one-time upfront (we enter your prices, staff and logo, install it and train your team at the salon), then ₹500 a month. All prices in Indian rupees.
